modes.cue_notes: Lie on your back and cross one leg over the other (like Eagle legs or a simple cross). Guide both legs to one side with the opposite hand while extending the other arm out. The crossed legs create a compound rotation that targets the IT band and outer hip more specifically than a simple reclining twist. Hold each side.

source: Traditional yin yoga; see Paul Grilley, Bernie Clark, Sarah Powers
notes: The leg crossing adds IT band and outer hip targeting to the basic reclining twist. Gallbladder meridian runs the lateral thigh and hip; liver the medial thigh. More targeted than standard reclining twist.
